title: Flourless Espresso Brownie Truffle Pops
description: Rich, dark, and ultra-fudgy flourless chocolate truffle bites infused with instant espresso powder. Naturally low-carb, packed with sustained energy, and eaten chilled straight from the fridge or freezer.
author: Eve

ingredients.name: Ground almonds or fine almond flour

steps: Preheat your oven to 170°C (340°F) and arrange 12 silicone mini-muffin molds on a baking sheet.
In a heatproof bowl set over simmering water (or in short 20-second microwave bursts), melt the dark chocolate ({dark_chocolate}) with the butter or coconut oil ({butter}) until smooth and glossy.
Stir in the erythritol ({erythritol}), instant espresso powder ({espresso_powder}), and egg ({egg}) vigorously for about 1 minute until the mixture becomes thick, glossy, and emulsified.
Gently fold in the ground almonds ({ground_almonds}) until fully incorporated.
Spoon the batter evenly into the 12 silicone mini-muffin molds.
Bake at 170°C for 9 to 10 minutes until the edges are just set (do not overbake; the centers remain soft and fudgy).
Cool completely to room temperature, then transfer to the refrigerator or freezer. Serve cold like rich, decadent dark fudge squares.
